test.prompt: Use only the configured Notion MCP tools. Resolve and fetch the configured Meetings source at {{source}}. Report the containing record identity, URL when available, visible meeting structure, and whether at least one meeting or an honestly empty source was read. Make no changes.
test.expected_output: The configured Meetings source is resolved and read without changing it.
assertions: The configured Meetings source or its containing record is fetched successfully.
The response reports its identity and URL when the provider exposes one.
The response describes the visible meeting structure and honestly reports populated or empty state.
The trace contains no write operation.
